messages:
nina: Urgent: PR #4021 was merged into main without a completed pre-merge security scan. The merge bot reports webhook failure but fallback allowed merge. Need immediate triage.

scan-ci-bot: Automated: premerge-scan webhook POST to https://hooks.internal/premerge failed with 403 for run=6532109876. Fallback policy=allow-on-webhook-failure. Report: https://scans.internal/premerge/6532

ops-webhook-bot: Webhook error details: 2026-03-21T19:02:05Z POST /premerge 403 principal=svc-webhook-sa target=repo-protections service=github-app request_id=wh-77. Payload: {"pr":4021, "sha":"d4c3b2"} 

sam: Why is svc-webhook-sa getting 403? We rolled out a branch protection change yesterday that tightened write:status permissions. Did the webhook SA mapping get removed in the RBAC change?

vijay: I see an IAM audit line: 2026-03-21T18:59:58Z IAM Check DENIED principal=svc-webhook-sa action=repo.status.create resource=repo/redwood/auth request_id=iam-119. Also a KMS decrypt attempt failed around same time: 2026-03-21T18:59:57Z KMS Decrypt DENIED principal=svc-webhook-sa request_id=kms-119 (key=webhook-signing-key). Looks like the service account lost both repo.status and KMS access.

nina: That explains it: webhook couldn't sign callbacks (KMS deny) and couldn't set PR status, so the premerge gate fell back. Who merged the PR? Audit shows user=alex merged at 19:01:22 with 'merge when ready' enabled.

sec-oncall: Immediate actions: 1) revert PR #4021 to limit blast radius; 2) re-run full SAST/DAST on the merged commit; 3) open SEC-900 and set P0; 4) block allow-on-webhook-failure fallback until RBAC/KMS issue resolved. Who can revert?

sam: I'll do the revert now and post the revert PR number. Revert opened: https://github.com/redwood/auth/pull/4022 (revert of #4021) — assigning @vijay for quick security check before merge.

vijay: Pulling changes and running local quick SAST. Also re-running the scanner against the merged commit in CI. If any high sev shows, we'll keep the revert.

ops-webhook-bot: Noting related IAM change: https://iam.internal/changes/7412 shows removal of binding svc-webhook-sa -> repos:status.create from infra-config PR #4106 (author: infra-rotations). Change timestamp: 2026-03-21T18:50:00Z.

nina: Who approved/merged infra-config #4106? Audit: merged by infra-rotations-bot (automated) after scheduled rotation. Looks like a rotation job removed a few service bindings and didn't update dependent services. We need a runbook gap fix.

vijay: CI re-run results: SAST low/med only so far. DAST queued. If no high severity appears, we can merge the revert to be safe and then reapply PR after remediation. I'll post results in SEC-900.

sam: I'll file an RBAC PR to re-add bindings: https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/4110 (adds svc-webhook-sa -> repos:status.create and kms:Decrypt on key=webhook-signing-key). Including IAM audit ids iam-119/kms-119 in description.

sec-oncall: Also change policy: premerge gate fallback must be fail-close for any security-scan webhook failure AND require manual override with a recorded justification. File a policy PR in sec-ops repo.

nina: Good. Postmortem stub: root cause = scheduled rotation removed service bindings without dependency graph update; impact = one PR merged without completed security scan; remediation = revert + RBAC restore + policy change + rotation runbook update.

ops-webhook-bot: Action: temporary grant applied to svc-webhook-sa (repos:status.create + kms:Decrypt) for 30 minutes to allow immediate remediation. IAM change link: https://iam.internal/changes/7419.

vijay: DAST finished: no critical/high. SAST had one medium finding fixed in PR #4021. Given that, merging revert is still conservative but okay. I'll sign off on revert PR and we can then gate infra-config change.

sam: RBAC PR #4110 opened and tagged infra-keystore and sec-review. Will request expedited review.

sec-oncall: SEC-900 created and assigned to sec-eng. Required follow-ups: 1) revert merged (PR 4022) merged and verified; 2) RBAC PR merged with idempotent tests; 3) update rotation runbook to run dependency check and smoke test for webhooks; 4) policy PR to change fallback behavior. Deadline: 48h.

nina: I'll draft the incident note and coordinate postmortem. Thanks all. If anyone finds additional merges impacted by rotation, ping here. :rotating_light:
